int_name: N BROAD ST & SAINT LUKES ST

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane arterial road with sidewalks but lacking visible marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals at the immediate intersection. The environment is designed primarily for high-volume vehicle throughput, creating a long and unprotected crossing for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalk
hazards.description: No visible painted crosswalk to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to their presence.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Design
hazards.description: Wide, straight lanes encourage higher vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder style crosswalk markings to increase visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility marked crosswalk and traffic signals with a 'No Turn on Red' sign, providing significant protection. However, the crossing distance is relatively wide without a refuge island, and dedicated pedestrian signals are not clearly visible in the image.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Lack of visible pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to guide crossing timing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide better information to crossing pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, two-lane roadway with a high-visibility continental crosswalk but lacks active pedestrian signals or signage. While a sidewalk and mature trees are present on one side, the long, unprotected crossing distance and straight road geometry may facilitate higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks any signage or signals to alert drivers, relying solely on pavement markings.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island or median.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility warning signs (W11-2) to alert approaching drivers of the crossing.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane signalized intersection in a commercial area with marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks. While basic infrastructure like signals and ramps are present, the long crossing distance and lack of a median refuge increase pedestrian exposure to traffic. The road surface is noticeably degraded with cracks throughout the intersection area.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to traffic for a long duration across multiple lanes without a refuge.

hazards.name: Pavement degradation
hazards.description: Significant cracking in the asphalt within the crosswalk area presents a potential trip hazard.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Build out the sidewalk at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked asphalt to provide a smooth, level surface for pedestrians.
